about.text: Casu martzu is a Sardinian sheep milk cheese that contains live fly maggots.

sources.text: The first paragraph of its article, shortened.
The photograph, its author and its licence, from its page.
Sardinian pecorino left open for Piophila casei fly larvae; fermentation about 3 months; sale banned

facts.v: Whole milk of the Sarda breed, made into pecorino
A lid (su tappu) is cut in one face to check and serve the creamy paste
Eaten spread on pane carasau once the larvae have declined
Italian and EU hygiene rules prohibit its production and sale; Sardinia has sought an EU DOP for it
